title: Antifreeze
description: Texture pack to help you stop falling in powder snow
body:
How it works:

It changes the powder snow texture to be more distinctive, because it looks like the snow block and is hard to tell from each other until it's too late.

NOTICE: if the pack says "made for older/newer version of minecraft" it's no big deal it still should work.

ALSO YOU NEED TO PUT THE PACK 1ST IN ORDER FOR IT TO WORK!!!

![put the pack first](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/009109f239891c918582ed8454d59a9e7f8b38b2.png)
